description: generate_chart: monthly revenue line chart and revenue-by-region bar chart.

steps.message: 画一个月度销售额趋势折线图，再画一个各区域销售额柱状图。

arguments.sql: SELECT SUBSTR(order_date, 1, 7) AS month, ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM sales GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
arguments.title: 月度销售额趋势
